Criterion 6 is therefore met at file level and open at function level, with the 23 bodies over 200 lines named as the starting point.

cohesionMethod: For every file with no recorded justification, top-level declarations were linked by mutual reference and grouped into connected components. A file that is one component cannot be split without exporting what is currently private; a file with several independent groups can.

functionAudit.method: Every function body over 80 lines was measured for branch count, case clauses, nested function declarations, await count and large object literals, then classified by the structural feature that accounts for its length. The classification is mechanical. It is a filter that separates length with a reason from length without one; it is not a line-by-line human review and does not claim to be.

justified.factory-container: the body is mostly nested function declarations, so it is a service object being assembled; splitting moves the nesting rather than removing it
justified.dispatch-table: eight or more case clauses over a closed set; splitting hides the set the dispatch is exhaustive over
justified.validation-chain: twelve or more branches with throws; a guard chain where length is the number of rules, each guard short
justified.record-builder: nearly half the body is one large object literal; the length is the shape of the record produced
